speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome, I am Dr. Agent. You mentioned sudden-onset lower back pain radiating down your leg; can you describe the exact location of the pain and tell me how many hours it has been since it started?

speaker: Patient
text: 26-year-old woman. The patient reports exercising in the gym several hours ago when she suddenly felt a sharp pain in her lower back. She describes the pain as radiating down the side of her leg and into her foot.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Lumbar Radiculopathy (likely L5 or S1) secondary to acute muscle strain or disc herniation.

To confirm the level of nerve involvement, I need to know if you have any numbness, tingling, or weakness in your foot or leg, and does the pain worsen when you cough or sneeze?
